re-4ixl.title: Google car: mirrors, roof rack, tape on rear right
re-4ixl.summary: A car with visible side mirrors and a roof rack. Black tape sits at the end of the rear right bar. Ghana's car has tape on the front right bar instead.

differs.how: Ghana's tape is on the front right bar

re-5wwx.title: Landscape: sugarcane fields
re-5wwx.summary: Sugarcane grows in the north-east and the south-west. The south-west is more built up, with more buildings and cars.

re-Ccd5.title: Landscape: green volcanic mountains, palms, ferns
re-Ccd5.summary: A mountainous volcanic island with lush green peaks close to coastal roads. Palms and ferns are common, pines higher up, and flowering plants everywhere.

differs.how: Similar latitude to Queensland but steep volcanic peaks

re-HNMA.title: Coverage: few roads without a backpack
re-HNMA.summary: Only a handful of roads were covered without the walking backpack. Learn the general areas with coverage to get closer guesses.

re-TYj8.title: Pole: French-style signs, bollards and poles
re-TYj8.summary: Road signs, bollards and poles are all French-style, as in mainland France.

re-UMXJ.title: Landscape: sparsely populated east, single carriageway
re-UMXJ.summary: The east is the least populated. The main road is a single carriageway with dense vegetation on both sides, or a wide open landscape with few trees.

re-UhQa.title: Bollard: black vs green with white ball top
re-UhQa.summary: At intersections, black bollards mean Saint Paul and green bollards, often with a white ball on top, mean Saint Denis. Saint Denis, the capital, is also more built up.

re-aap9.title: Road: winding dark dirt track, pines, eucalyptus
re-aap9.summary: A winding dark dirt track with grass growing down the middle, surrounded by dense vegetation, especially pine trees and eucalyptus.

re-e1PC.title: Landscape: Mars-like brown-red volcanic soil
re-e1PC.summary: A Mars-like landscape with brown-red soil and only scattered shrubs. White stones line the road. This is the road to the volcano.

re-gOIT.title: Road: divided highway, ridge one side, sea the other
re-gOIT.summary: A divided road with a distinct ridge to the south-east and the ocean to the north-west. The new bridge on the map is not visible because coverage is older.

re-gdWo.title: Coverage: island in the Indian Ocean
re-gdWo.summary: A French overseas department east of Madagascar. For country streaks it counts as France.

re-m512.title: Landscape: town ringed by a wall of mountains
re-m512.summary: A town inside a caldera, surrounded by a wall of mountains, with overcast skies. This is Cilaos.

re-nllT.title: Google car: rectangular blur at the front
re-nllT.summary: A rectangular blur on the front camera appears in all coverage north of Saint-Louis.

re-oFny.title: Bus stop: six designs (yellow, L-shaped, pink...)
re-oFny.summary: Six bus stop types: yellow (most common, usually next to another stop), L-shaped white or olive, pink, orange, green and red. A lone yellow stop hints at the region; the map shows where each type is.
